title: Greer says the octagon craft is made by Lockheed Skunk Works

tellings.quote: I mean, it's been talked about publicly by Greer, but he always says that he knows the craft you saw, the souped up version of the agon retrieved is made by the Lockheit skull works in North Brumit.

plain: An octagon-shaped craft that was retrieved, in a souped-up version, is built by Lockheed's Skunk Works, the secret design division of the aerospace company Lockheed, at a place given as "North Brumit". A witness who goes by the online name UAPGerb says this, repeating what he says a man named Steven Greer has said publicly about it. He says it to a fellow guest, Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, and if true it would mean the craft Herrera saw was a human-made machine.
